dimensionTargets.basis: Converted from rounded dimensions in Lexus US 2000 brochure. Overall width excludes mirrors. Target scale is not dimensional validation.

openIssues: The specification sheet lists 55.9 inches height but its diagram shows 56.7; brochure 55.9 used provisionally.
OEM archived pages disagree on 215/60R16 versus 225/60R16 tires. Wheel/tire details need placard confirmation.
No factory CAD or measurements of mechanical parts supplied.
Generic transmission internals only; gear/valve-body engineering not represented.
